observations: Global rings and source picture remain continuous across partition boundaries.
Local marks restart in each panel; PImage crops preserve the selected parts of the source picture.
Feathered edges expose the background grid and create visible gutters. This is appropriate for soft cutouts, not seamless inter-effect crossfade.
decision: Retain callback/coordinate/mask separation. Add explicit two-input crossfade before claiming soft transitions between arbitrary translucent layers. Public adapter and distribution remain pending.
limits: Original input is generated, not a decoded external photograph; asset loading/license handling not proved.
Private helper uses full-canvas scratch per region and extra output copies; no large partition-count performance acceptance.
No automatic crop selection or semantic feature extraction.
